before.heading: Help customers check the stand before planning a trip.
before.intro: A crop list explains what a farm grows across the season. A dated notice and current hours help a customer decide whether to visit now. Your stand page can give those facts separate purposes and a realistic way to keep changing details current.
before.customerQuestion: The farm grows tomatoes. How can I check whether they are available before I drive over?

decisions.label: Label the seasonal range
decisions.body: Present owner-approved crops and photographs as general context. Avoid wording that turns every listed crop into a promise of stock on the customer’s next visit.

decisions.label: Make the latest approved notice recognizable
decisions.body: Give a current harvest or stand highlight its date and useful duration. Agree who approves replacement wording when a crop ends, so an old highlight does not conflict with the permanent introduction.

decisions.label: Connect the update to a visit
decisions.body: Keep actual hours, changes and a contact route nearby. Explain what staff can confirm before travel, including uncertainty about a particular item, without implying live inventory or immediate replies.

ownerInputs: Approved crop list, photographs and current notice.
Stand schedule and contact for availability questions.
Named updater, approval process and publishing arrangement.
before.sourceBridge: Story Farms publishes a homegrown produce list, farm news and stand hours from its Catskill address at 4640 NY-32. Those pieces answer different questions: the farm’s range, its latest message and when to arrive. Their usefulness depends on keeping each kind of information clear.
before.limits: Ordinary website care is not an instant or round-the-clock harvest-news service. Agree the work window and supply approved wording, intended dates and related hours changes together. Frequent same-day publishing needs assessment before booking; live stock, preorders and automated feeds require separate scope.

decisions.body: No: “every other Saturday” does not identify the next date, an available slot or walk-in permission. A useful administrative question is: “Which scheduled MRI date has been confirmed for my visit, and where will the authorized team send preparation instructions?” The staff confirmation must supply the actual date and next step. This example does not choose a test, assess urgency or establish clinical availability.

decisions.label: Keep patient visiting on its own route
decisions.body: Separate a service inquiry from visiting a patient and use the approved visiting instructions rather than copying hospital operating hours. Keep patient-specific preparation and health records in the authorized process. The source’s clinic-address variants are not used as directions in this example.

ownerInputs: Approved named-service categories and normal/on-call/mobile schedule wording.
Actual scheduling contacts and owner confirming recurring-service dates.
Current patient-visiting information and authorized patient-specific preparation route.
after.sourceBridge: Knox County Hospital District distinguishes normal radiology hours, after-hours on-call provision and recurring mobile imaging schedules. The example uses those different schedule types to show why a calendar pattern needs a separate appointment confirmation.
after.limits: A focused edit can distinguish the hours and schedule labels already published. A fuller project can connect the service directory, visitor information and staff handoffs. Scheduling systems, patient portals, clinical advice and medical-record handling require separate assessment and appropriate professional responsibility.

requiredFixes: Strengthen practical task clarity with an explicit worked example; preserve factual and commercial limits.

limits: Existing verified factual scope unchanged. Worked examples are illustrative, with no new provider terms, dates, capacities or clinical advice. Final ratings remain for independent review.

acceptance.scope: Content only; family, visual, accessibility and release checks remain separate.
